<div id="lstnumberx133" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx133.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">fill</span>(<span id="lstnumberx133.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_string">’a12’</span>,<span id="lstnumberx133.3" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx133.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_string">’example<span id="lstnumberx133.4.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space">␣</span>with<span id="lstnumberx133.4.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space">␣</span>"quotes"’</span>)

<section id="A2" class="ltx_appendix">
<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_title_appendix"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_appendix">Appendix B </span>Detailed Benchmark Descriptions</h2>

<section id="A2.SS0.SSS0.Px1" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">MiniWoB</h5>
<span id="footnote15" class="ltx_note ltx_role_footnote"><sup class="ltx_note_mark">15</sup><span class="ltx_note_outer"><span class="ltx_note_content"><sup class="ltx_note_mark">15</sup>
          <span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_note">15</span>
          
          
          
          
          
          
          
        <a href="https://miniwob.farama.org/" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_url ltx_font_typewriter">https://miniwob.farama.org/</a></span></span></span>
<div id="A2.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A2.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_citep">(<a href="#bib.bib50" title="" class="ltx_ref">Shi et al., 2017</a>; <a href="#bib.bib33" title="" class="ltx_ref">Liu et al., 2018</a>)</cite> Each task only requires accessing a single HTML page, the entire logic of the task and its validation is done in JavaScript. As such, MiniWoB natively supports parallelization since there are no collisions by design.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A2.SS0.SSS0.Px2" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">WebArena</h5>
<span id="footnote16" class="ltx_note ltx_role_footnote"><sup class="ltx_note_mark">16</sup><span class="ltx_note_outer"><span class="ltx_note_content"><sup class="ltx_note_mark">16</sup>
          <span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_note">16</span>
          
          
          
          
          
          
          
        <a href="https://webarena.dev/" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_url ltx_font_typewriter">https://webarena.dev/</a></span></span></span>
<div id="A2.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A2.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_citep">(<a href="#bib.bib75" title="" class="ltx_ref">Zhou et al., 2024b</a>)</cite> Contains 6 domains mimicking real-world websites, self-hosted via Docker containers. Docker containers must be reset to their initial state before each new agent evaluation. Task validation is performed via logic rules (HTML content, URL match, message content), using either exact matching or semantic matching using a GPT-3.5 model as a judge (hence implies some costs).</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A2.SS0.SSS0.Px3" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">VisualWebArena</h5>
<span id="footnote17" class="ltx_note ltx_role_footnote"><sup class="ltx_note_mark">17</sup><span class="ltx_note_outer"><span class="ltx_note_content"><sup class="ltx_note_mark">17</sup>
          <span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_note">17</span>
          
          
          
          
          
          
          
        <a href="https://github.com/web-arena-x/visualwebarena" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_url ltx_font_typewriter">https://github.com/web-arena-x/visualwebarena</a></span></span></span>
<div id="A2.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A2.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_citep">(<a href="#bib.bib28" title="" class="ltx_ref">Koh et al., 2024a</a>)</cite> Based on the WebArena implementation, VisualWebArena retains 2 of the original domains, plus includes a new one. Task goals include images for vision-based tasks, such as “Find a pair of shoes that looks like this image”. Docker containers must be reset to their initial state before each new agent evaluation, and some tasks require an explicit reset of a specific Docker. Task validation is similar to WebArena, and also relies on visual matching using an open-source VLM (<span id="A2.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">blip2-flan-t5-xl</span>).</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A2.SS0.SSS0.Px4" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">WorkArena</h5>
<span id="footnote18" class="ltx_note ltx_role_footnote"><sup class="ltx_note_mark">18</sup><span class="ltx_note_outer"><span class="ltx_note_content"><sup class="ltx_note_mark">18</sup>
          <span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_note">18</span>
          
          
          
          
          
          
          
        <a href="https://servicenow.github.io/WorkArena/" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_url ltx_font_typewriter">https://servicenow.github.io/WorkArena/</a></span></span></span>
<div id="A2.SS0.SSS0.Px4.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A2.SS0.SSS0.Px4.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_citep">(<a href="#bib.bib10" title="" class="ltx_ref">Drouin et al., 2024</a>; <a href="#bib.bib3" title="" class="ltx_ref">Boisvert et al., 2024</a>)</cite> The backend platform requires a Personal Developer Instance (PDI), available on demand with a free ServiceNow user account. Validation is done via logic rules, using database queries to check for specific content in the backend, and JavaScript code injected on the platform’s pages to check for specific actions in the frontend. WorkArena natively supports large-scale parallel agent evaluation, as it prevents trajectory collisions by design.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A2.SS0.SSS0.Px5" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">AssistantBench</h5>
<span id="footnote19" class="ltx_note ltx_role_footnote"><sup class="ltx_note_mark">19</sup><span class="ltx_note_outer"><span class="ltx_note_content"><sup class="ltx_note_mark">19</sup>
          <span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_note">19</span>
          
          
          
          
          
          
          
        <a href="https://assistantbench.github.io/" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_url ltx_font_typewriter">https://assistantbench.github.io/</a></span></span></span>
<div id="A2.SS0.SSS0.Px5.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A2.SS0.SSS0.Px5.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_citep">(<a href="#bib.bib68" title="" class="ltx_ref">Yoran et al., 2024</a>)</cite> Contains 214 realistic and time-consuming open-domain tasks. Tasks require browsing more than 525 web pages from 258 different websites to answer correctly. The dataset covers a diverse range of topics and is composed of a sub-set of general assistant tasks and a sub-set of domain-specific tasks created by domain experts.
The benchmark features a small development set, consisting of 33 tasks and a larger test set of 181 tasks. The gold answers are hidden for the test, but released for the development set in addition to the URLs from which the answers can be inferred and and answering strategies.
Additional task-level metadata includes difficulty and time-dependency, indicating whether the answer is static or includes stable information that could change in the future, e.g., a business’s opening hours.
Since the test set is hidden, predictions need to be submitted for evaluation. This is supported via an API to enable easy evaluations at scale.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A2.SS0.SSS0.Px6" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h5 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph">WebLINX</h5>
<span id="footnote20" class="ltx_note ltx_role_footnote"><sup class="ltx_note_mark">20</sup><span class="ltx_note_outer"><span class="ltx_note_content"><sup class="ltx_note_mark">20</sup>
          <span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_note">20</span>
          
          
          
          
          
          
          
        <a href="https://mcgill-nlp.github.io/weblinx/" title="" class="ltx_ref ltx_url ltx_font_typewriter">https://mcgill-nlp.github.io/weblinx/</a></span></span></span>
<div id="A2.SS0.SSS0.Px6.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A2.SS0.SSS0.Px6.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_citep">(<a href="#bib.bib36" title="" class="ltx_ref">Lù et al., 2024</a>)</cite> Static, supervised benchmark. Interaction traces in the original dataset are converted to the BrowserGym observation/action format, and each task consists of predicting an action that must match a recorded action taken by a human during a demonstration. As a result, it differs from environment-based benchmarks by ending after one step, while formulating each recorded action as a different task. Consequently, validation produces scalar rewards via partial matching, using the original metrics selected by <cite class="ltx_cite ltx_citemacro_citet"><a href="#bib.bib36" title="" class="ltx_ref">Lù et al. (2024)</a></cite>.</p>
</div>
<div class="ltx_pagination ltx_role_newpage"></div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="A3" class="ltx_appendix">

</div>

style="font-size:50%;--ltx-fg-color:#000000;"># Instructions
Review the current state of the page and all other information to find the best
possible next action to accomplish your goal. Your answer will be interpreted
and executed by a program, make sure to follow the formatting instructions.

## Goal:

Managing Your Existing Expenses

 Concretely, you need to complete the following steps:
1. Navigate to the "Expense Lines" module of the "Cost" application.
2. Create a filter for the list to extract all entries where:
    - "Short description" contains "#SERIES-d1e0dc99-5"
3. Delete expense lines with duplicated short descriptions, keeping only the most expensive duplicate.

# Observation of current step:

## Currently open tabs:
Tab 0 (active tab):
    Title: Home | ServiceNow
    URL: https://dev255323.service-now.com/now/nav/ui/home

## AXTree:
Note: [bid] is the unique alpha-numeric identifier at the beginning of lines for each element in the AXTree. Always use bid to refer to elements in your actions.

Note: You can only interact with visible elements. If the "visible" tag is not
present, the element is not visible on the page.

RootWebArea ’Classic | Unified Navigation App | ServiceNow’
        [47] generic, live=’assertive’, atomic, relevant=’additions text’
        [48] generic, live=’polite’, atomic, relevant=’additions text’

...

# History of interaction with the task:

## step 0

&lt;think&gt;
Looking at the current page, I need to navigate to the "Expense Lines" module in the "Cost" application. First, I need to access the "All" menu since it’s likely where
I’ll find the Cost application. The "All" menu button is visible with bid "79".
&lt;/think&gt;

&lt;action&gt;
click(’79’)
&lt;/action&gt;

## step 1

&lt;think&gt;
I see that the "All" menu is already expanded. I need to find the "Cost" application in the list of applications. Looking through the AXTree, I can see various
applications listed, but I need to search for "Cost" since it’s not immediately visible. I can use the search box at the top of the All menu which has bid "242" and
is currently focused.
&lt;/think&gt;

&lt;action&gt;
fill(’242’, ’Cost’)
&lt;/action&gt;

## step 2

&lt;think&gt;
I can see that the search box is already filled with "Cost" and the menu is showing filtered results. I can see the "Expense Lines" link with bid "1145" which is exactly
what I need to navigate to. I’ll click on this link to access the Expense Lines module.
&lt;/think&gt;

&lt;action&gt;
click(’1145’)
&lt;/action&gt;


# Action space:
Note: This action set allows you to interact with your environment. Most of them
are python function executing playwright code. The primary way of referring to
elements in the page is through bid which are specified in your observations.


20 different types of actions are available.

noop(wait_ms: float = 1000)
send_msg_to_user(text: str)
report_infeasible(reason: str)
scroll(delta_x: float, delta_y: float)
fill(bid: str, value: str)
select_option(bid: str, options: str | list[str])
click(bid: str, button: Literal[’left’, ’middle’, ’right’] = ’left’, modifiers: list[typing.Literal[’Alt’, ’Control’, ’ControlOrMeta’, ’Meta’, ’Shift’]] = [])
dblclick(bid: str, button: Literal[’left’, ’middle’, ’right’] = ’left’, modifiers: list[typing.Literal[’Alt’, ’Control’, ’ControlOrMeta’, ’Meta’, ’Shift’]] = [])
hover(bid: str)
press(bid: str, key_comb: str)
focus(bid: str)
clear(bid: str)
drag_and_drop(from_bid: str, to_bid: str)
upload_file(bid: str, file: str | list[str])
tab_close()
tab_focus(index: int)
new_tab()
go_back()
go_forward()
goto(url: str)
Only a single action can be provided at once. Example:
fill(’a12’, ’example with "quotes"’)

Note:
* Some tasks may be game like and may require to interact with the mouse position
in x, y coordinates.
* Some text field might have auto completion. To see it, you have to type a few
characters and wait until next step.
* If you have to cut and paste, don’t forget to select the text first.
* Coordinate inside an SVG are relative to it’s top left corner.
* Make sure to use bid to identify elements when using commands.
* Interacting with combobox, dropdowns and auto-complete fields can be tricky,
sometimes you need to use select_option, while other times you need to use fill
or click and wait for the reaction of the page.


# Abstract Example

Here is an abstract version of the answer with description of the content of
each tag. Make sure you follow this structure, but replace the content with your
answer:

&lt;think&gt;
Think step by step. If you need to make calculations such as coordinates, write them here. Describe the effect
that your previous action had on the current content of the page.
&lt;/think&gt;

&lt;action&gt;
One single action to be executed. You can only use one action at a time.
&lt;/action&gt;


# Concrete Example

Here is a concrete example of how to format your answer.
Make sure to follow the template with proper tags:

&lt;think&gt;
From previous action I tried to set the value of year to "2022",
using select_option, but it doesn’t appear to be in the form. It may be a
dynamic dropdown, I will try using click with the bid "a324" and look at the
response from the page.
&lt;/think&gt;

&lt;action&gt;
click(’a324’)
&lt;/action&gt;
</pre></span></span></foreignObject></g></g></svg></span>

<section id="A5" class="ltx_appendix">
<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_title_appendix"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_appendix">Appendix E </span>Benchmark setting</h2>

<div id="A5.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A5.p1.1" class="ltx_p">In Table <a href="#A5.T5" title="Table 5 ‣ Appendix E Benchmark setting ‣ The BrowserGym Ecosystem for Web Agent Research" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">5</span></a> we give some more information about the benchmark settings during our experiments. For Miniwob and WorkArena L1, we use respectively 5 and 10 seeds per task. WebArena and its visual counterpart are meant to be used as a whole, as they do not provide task seeding. WorkArena L2 and L3 are shipped with preset curricula to balance out the types of tasks in an experiment. Finally, AssistantBench and WebLINX provide test sets, which are used to evaluate the models.</p>
</div>

<section id="A6" class="ltx_appendix">

<div id="A6.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">

We also show token counts. We highlight that the Llama models were ran using the OpenRouter API, which relies on different providers to give users access to those models. Prices for those two models may have changed since running our experiments.</p>

<section id="A7" class="ltx_appendix">
<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_title_appendix"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_appendix">Appendix G </span>Experiment runtime and hardware</h2>

<div id="A7.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A7.p1.1" class="ltx_p">We provide detailed information on total runtimes and benchmark durations (<a href="#A7.T7" title="In Appendix G Experiment runtime and hardware ‣ The BrowserGym Ecosystem for Web Agent Research" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">Table</span> <span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">7</span></a>). These metrics are presented for our best-performing model, Claude 3.5 Sonnet. For each benchmark, we report the following key metrics:</p>
</div>
<div id="A7.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<ul id="A7.I1" class="ltx_itemize">
<li id="A7.I1.i1" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A7.I1.i1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A7.I1.i1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A7.I1.i1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Cumulative Experiment Duration</span>: The overall time taken for the benchmark experiment to complete. This value does not account for parallelization.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="A7.I1.i2" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A7.I1.i2.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A7.I1.i2.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A7.I1.i2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Average Step Duration</span>: The mean time taken per step in the experiment.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="A7.I1.i3" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A7.I1.i3.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A7.I1.i3.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A7.I1.i3.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Cumulative Environment Runtime</span>: The total time spent running the environment, excluding agent processing time.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="A7.I1.i4" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A7.I1.i4.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A7.I1.i4.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A7.I1.i4.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Average Environment Runtime per Step</span>: The average time spent by the environment per step.</p>
</div></li>
<li id="A7.I1.i5" class="ltx_item" style="list-style-type:none;"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_item">•</span> 
<div id="A7.I1.i5.p1" class="ltx_para">
<p id="A7.I1.i5.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A7.I1.i5.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">Cumulative Number of Environment Steps</span>: The total count of steps executed within the environment during the experiment.</p>
</div></li>
</ul>
</div>
<div id="A7.p3" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A7.p3.1" class="ltx_p">Discrepancies between the total runtime and environment runtime can be observed, primarily due to the API used. Slower or overcrowded APIs may introduce significant variations.</p>
</div>
<div id="A7.p4" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A7.p4.1" class="ltx_p">It is important to note that the reported durations do not account for parallelization. In practice, experiments were conducted using up to 20 parallel jobs depending on the benchmark. This means that while the reported total experiment duration reflects the absolute runtime of the benchmark, the actual time required to complete an experiment may be significantly lower due to parallel execution. The level of parallelization was adjusted based on the computational requirements of each benchmark. Lighter benchmarks, such as MiniWoB, could support up to 20 parallel runs without issue, whereas more resource-intensive benchmarks, like WebArena or WorkArena, required limiting parallel jobs to prevent server overload and ensure stable execution.</p>
</div>
<div id="A7.p5" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A7.p5.1" class="ltx_p">Our experiments were conducted on large-scale compute clusters equipped with Intel(R) Xeon(R) Gold 6126 CPUs @ 2.60GHz and effectively unlimited RAM. Given the relatively low computational demands of our benchmarks, experiments could also be run locally on standard laptops without significant performance degradation. However, the primary constraints arise from the benchmark environments themselves. For example, WebArena experiments were executed on Azure VMs with 8 CPUs and 32GB RAM, which imposed limitations on execution speed and parallelization capabilities.</p>
</div>

<section id="A8" class="ltx_appendix">
<h2 class="ltx_title ltx_title_appendix"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_appendix">Appendix H </span>Results analysis</h2>

<div id="A8.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A8.p1.1" class="ltx_p">In this section, we compare the execution of a task by our <span id="A8.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_lst_language_python ltx_lstlisting">GenericAgent</span>, backed by two different LLMs, Claude 3.5 Sonnet which executed the task correctly, and GPT-4o which failed the task.
We will be looking at a task from the very challenging WorkArena L2, on which Claude achieves groundbreaking performances.</p>
</div>
<div id="A8.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A8.p2.1" class="ltx_p">We focus on the task <span id="A8.p2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_language_python ltx_lstlisting"><span id="A8.p2.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">workarena</span>.<span id="A8.p2.1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">servicenow</span>.<span id="A8.p2.1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">navigate</span>-<span id="A8.p2.1.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_keyword ltx_font_bold">and</span>-<span id="A8.p2.1.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">order</span>-<span id="A8.p2.1.1.6" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">standard</span>-<span id="A8.p2.1.1.7" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">laptop</span>-<span id="A8.p2.1.1.8" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">l2</span></span>, which has the following goal:</p>
</div>
<div id="A8.p3" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">

<div id="lstnumberx190" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx190.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">Order</span><span id="lstnumberx190.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx190.3" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">a</span><span id="lstnumberx190.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx190.5" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">standard</span><span id="lstnumberx190.6" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx190.7" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">laptop</span><span id="lstnumberx190.8" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx190.9" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">from</span><span id="lstnumberx190.10" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx190.11" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">the</span><span id="lstnumberx190.12" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx190.13" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">service</span><span id="lstnumberx190.14" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx190.15" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">catalog</span>
</div>
<div id="lstnumberx191" class="ltx_listingline">
</div>
<div id="lstnumberx192" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx192.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx192.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">Concretely</span>,<span id="lstnumberx192.3" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx192.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">you</span><span id="lstnumberx192.5" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx192.6" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">need</span><span id="lstnumberx192.7" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx192.8" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">to</span><span id="lstnumberx192.9" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx192.10" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">complete</span><span id="lstnumberx192.11" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx192.12" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">the</span><span id="lstnumberx192.13" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx192.14" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">following</span><span id="lstnumberx192.15" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx192.16" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">steps</span>:

<div id="A8.p4" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A8.p4.1" class="ltx_p"><a href="#A8.F12" title="In Appendix H Results analysis ‣ The BrowserGym Ecosystem for Web Agent Research" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">Figure</span> <span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">12</span></a> displays the trajectory taken by Claude for this task. Interestingly, in step <a href="#A8.F12.sf5" title="Figure 12(e) ‣ Figure 12 ‣ Appendix H Results analysis ‣ The BrowserGym Ecosystem for Web Agent Research" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">12(e)</span></a> the agent manages to overcome an environment limitation. Clicking on one of the element of the checkbox does not trigger the checkbox, and the agent gives the following reasoning before correctly checking the checkbox:</p>
<div id="A8.p4.2" class="ltx_listing ltx_lst_language_text ltx_lstlisting ltx_listing"><div class="ltx_listing_data"><a href="data:text/plain;base64," download="">⬇</a></div>
<div id="lstnumberx195" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx195.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">I</span><span id="lstnumberx195.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span </span><span id="lstnumberx195.11" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">on</span><span id="lstnumberx195.12" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx195.13" class="ltx_text id="lstnumberx195.16" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx195.17" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">didn</span>’<span id="lstnumberx195.18" class="ltx_text </span><span id="lstnumberx195.32" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">events</span>.<span id="lstnumberx195.33" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx195.34" class="ltx_text </span><span id="lstnumberx195.40" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">AXTree</span>,<span id="lstnumberx195.41" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx195.42" class="ltx_text </span>"<span id="lstnumberx195.64" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">a184</span>".<span id="lstnumberx195.65" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx195.66" class="ltx_text </span><span id="lstnumberx195.75" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">the</span><span id="lstnumberx195.76" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx195.77" class="ltx_text </div>
</div>
<div id="A8.p5" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A8.p5.1" class="ltx_p">The agent then proceeds to complete the task.</p>
</div>
<div id="A8.p6" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A8.p6.1" class="ltx_p">On the other hand, <a href="#A8.F13" title="In Appendix H Results analysis ‣ The BrowserGym Ecosystem for Web Agent Research" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">Figure</span> <span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">13</span></a> displays the last two steps from the same task, executed by GPT-4o. The agent does not notice it is only ordering one laptop instead of the required 6, failing the task.</p>
</div>
<div id="A8.p7" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A8.p7.1" class="ltx_p">More precisely, the agent attempts to click on element <span id="A8.p7.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_lst_language_python ltx_lstlisting">a243</span> instead of using the <span id="A8.p7.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier ltx_lst_language_python ltx_lstlisting">select_option</span> action in the following AXTree:</p>
<div id="A8.p7.2" class="ltx_listing ltx_lst_language_text ltx_lstlisting ltx_listing"><div class="ltx_listing_data"><a href="data:text/plain;base64," download="">⬇</a></div>
<div id="lstnumberx196" class="ltx_listingline">[<span id="lstnumberx196.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">a237</span>]<span id="lstnumberx196.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx196.3" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">combobox</span><span id="lstnumberx196.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span>’<span id="lstnumberx196.5" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">Quantity</span>’<span id="lstnumberx196.6" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx196.7" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">value</span>=’1’,<span id="lstnumberx196.8" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx196.9" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">visible</span>,<span id="lstnumberx196.10" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx196.11" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">hasPopup</span>=’<span id="lstnumberx196.12" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">menu</span>’,<span id="lstnumberx196.13" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx196.14" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">expanded</span>=<span id="lstnumberx196.15" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">False</span>,<span id="lstnumberx196.16" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx196.17" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">controls</span>=’<span id="lstnumberx196.18" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">quantity_label_span</span>’
</div>
<div id="lstnumberx197" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx197.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space">    </span>[<span id="lstnumberx197.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">a238</span>]<span id="lstnumberx197.3" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx197.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">menuitem</span><span id="lstnumberx197.5" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span>’1’,<span id="lstnumberx197.6" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx197.7" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">selected</span>=<span id="lstnumberx197.8" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">True</span>
</div>
<div id="lstnumberx198" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx198.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space">    </span>[<span id="lstnumberx198.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">a239</span>]<span id="lstnumberx198.3" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx198.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">menuitem</span><span id="lstnumberx198.5" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span>’2’,<span id="lstnumberx198.6" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx198.7" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">selected</span>=<span id="lstnumberx198.8" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">False</span>
</div>
<div id="lstnumberx199" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx199.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space">    </span>[<span id="lstnumberx199.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">a240</span>]<span id="lstnumberx199.3" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx199.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">menuitem</span><span id="lstnumberx199.5" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span>’3’,<span id="lstnumberx199.6" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx199.7" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">selected</span>=<span id="lstnumberx199.8" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">False</span>
</div>
<div id="lstnumberx200" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx200.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space">    </span>[<span id="lstnumberx200.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">a241</span>]<span id="lstnumberx200.3" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx200.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">menuitem</span><span id="lstnumberx200.5" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span>’4’,<span id="lstnumberx200.6" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx200.7" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">selected</span>=<span id="lstnumberx200.8" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">False</span>
</div>
<div id="lstnumberx201" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx201.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space">    </span>[<span id="lstnumberx201.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">a242</span>]<span id="lstnumberx201.3" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx201.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">menuitem</span><span id="lstnumberx201.5" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span>’5’,<span id="lstnumberx201.6" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx201.7" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">selected</span>=<span id="lstnumberx201.8" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">False</span>
</div>
<div id="lstnumberx202" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx202.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space">    </span>[<span id="lstnumberx202.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">a243</span>]<span id="lstnumberx202.3" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx202.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">menuitem</span><span id="lstnumberx202.5" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span>’6’,<span id="lstnumberx202.6" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx202.7" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">selected</span>=<span id="lstnumberx202.8" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">False</span>
</div>
<div id="lstnumberx203" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx203.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space">    </span>[<span id="lstnumberx203.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">a244</span>]<span id="lstnumberx203.3" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx203.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">menuitem</span><span id="lstnumberx203.5" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span>’7’,<span id="lstnumberx203.6" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx203.7" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">selected</span>=<span id="lstnumberx203.8" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">False</span>
</div>
<div id="lstnumberx204" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx204.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space">    </span>[<span id="lstnumberx204.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">a245</span>]<span id="lstnumberx204.3" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx204.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">menuitem</span><span id="lstnumberx204.5" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span>’8’,<span id="lstnumberx204.6" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx204.7" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">selected</span>=<span id="lstnumberx204.8" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">False</span>
</div>
<div id="lstnumberx205" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx205.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space">    </span>[<span id="lstnumberx205.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">a246</span>]<span id="lstnumberx205.3" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx205.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">menuitem</span><span id="lstnumberx205.5" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span>’9’,<span id="lstnumberx205.6" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx205.7" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">selected</span>=<span id="lstnumberx205.8" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">False</span>
</div>
<div id="lstnumberx206" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx206.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space">    </span>[<span id="lstnumberx206.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">a247</span>]<span id="lstnumberx206.3" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx206.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">menuitem</span><span id="lstnumberx206.5" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span>’10’,<span id="lstnumberx206.6" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx206.7" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">selected</span>=<span id="lstnumberx206.8" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">False</span>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div id="A8.p8" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A8.p8.1" class="ltx_p">This causes the action to fail. However, seeing the previous Chain-of-thought reasoning in its prompt, GPT-4o continues with the following:</p>
</div>
<div id="A8.p9" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<div id="A8.p9.1" class="ltx_listing ltx_lst_language_text ltx_lstlisting ltx_listing"><div class="ltx_listing_data"><a href="data:text/plain;base64,SSBuZWVkIHRvIHByb2NlZWQgd2l0aCBjb25maWd1cmluZyB0aGUgIlN0YW5kYXJkIExhcHRvcCIgb3JkZXIuIFRoZSBxdWFudGl0eSBoYXMgYmVlbiBzZXQgdG8gNi4gTm93LCBJIHNob3VsZCBjaGVjayB0aGUgYm94ZXMgZm9yICJBZG9iZSBBY3JvYmF0IiBhbmQgIkFkb2JlIFBob3Rvc2hvcCIgdG8gaW5jbHVkZSB0aGVtIGluIHRoZSBvcmRlci4=" download="">⬇</a></div>
<div id="lstnumberx207" class="ltx_listingline"><span id="lstnumberx207.1" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">I</span><span id="lstnumberx207.2" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx207.3" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">need</span><span id="lstnumberx207.4" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx207.5" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">to</span><span id="lstnumberx207.6" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx207.7" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">proceed</span><span id="lstnumberx207.8" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx207.9" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">with</span><span id="lstnumberx207.10" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx207.11" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">configuring</span><span id="lstnumberx207.12" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx207.13" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">the</span><span id="lstnumberx207.14" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span>"<span id="lstnumberx207.15" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">Standard</span><span id="lstnumberx207.16" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx207.17" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">Laptop</span>"<span id="lstnumberx207.18" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx207.19" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">order</span>.<span id="lstnumberx207.20" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx207.21" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">The</span><span id="lstnumberx207.22" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx207.23" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">quantity</span><span id="lstnumberx207.24" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx207.25" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">has</span><span id="lstnumberx207.26" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx207.27" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">been</span><span id="lstnumberx207.28" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx207.29" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">set</span><span id="lstnumberx207.30" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx207.31" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">to</span><span id="lstnumberx207.32" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span>6.<span id="lstnumberx207.33" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx207.34" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">Now</span>,<span id="lstnumberx207.35" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx207.36" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">I</span><span id="lstnumberx207.37" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx207.38" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">should</span><span id="lstnumberx207.39" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx207.40" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">check</span><span id="lstnumberx207.41" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx207.42" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">the</span><span id="lstnumberx207.43" id="lstnumberx207.51" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx207.52" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">and</span><span id="lstnumberx207.53" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span>"<span id="lstnumberx207.54" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">Adobe</span><span id="lstnumberx207.55" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx207.56" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">Photoshop</span>"<span id="lstnumberx207.57" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx207.58" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">to</span><span id="lstnumberx207.59" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx207.60" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">include</span><span id="lstnumberx207.61" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx207.62" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">them</span><span id="lstnumberx207.63" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx207.64" class="ltx_text class="ltx_text ltx_lst_space"> </span><span id="lstnumberx207.68" class="ltx_text ltx_lst_identifier">order</span>.
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div id="A8.p10" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A8.p10.1" class="ltx_p">The agent fools itself and does not understand that the previous action was in fact a failure. It then goes on to complete the task without correcting this mistake.</p>
</div>

    <p><strong>Tip:</strong> You can select the relevant text first, to include it in your report.</p>
    <p>Our team has already identified <a class="ltx_ref" href="https://github.com/arXiv/html_feedback/issues"

      all.</p>
